appFieldsDraft.titleEn: I was dismissed from work. What should I do first?
appFieldsDraft.titleSw: Nimefukuzwa kazi. Nianzie wapi?
appFieldsDraft.summaryEn: Act promptly. A dismissal complaint has its own referral time limit; gather the dismissal facts and check the correct labour route before waiting for negotiations.
appFieldsDraft.summarySw: Chukua hatua mapema. Malalamiko ya kufukuzwa yana muda wake wa kuwasilishwa; kusanya taarifa na thibitisha njia ya kushughulikia mgogoro kabla ya kusubiri mazungumzo.
stepsEn: Save the dismissal letter, contract, payslips, messages and dates of notification and last work.
Write a short timeline and identify whether you challenge the reason, procedure, unpaid benefits or all three.
Contact CMA or a labour legal-aid adviser promptly about referral, the prescribed form and any late-filing application.
Keep a copy and reference number for every submission. Confirm the applicable deadline, official fee and next appointment; internal discussions do not automatically extend a filing deadline.
stepsSw: Hifadhi barua ya kufukuzwa, mkataba, hati za malipo, ujumbe na tarehe za taarifa na siku ya mwisho kazini.
Andika mfuatano mfupi wa matukio na eleza kama unapinga sababu, utaratibu, mafao ambayo hayajalipwa au yote.
Wasiliana mapema na CMA au mtoa msaada wa sheria za kazi kuhusu kuwasilisha mgogoro, fomu na ombi la kuchelewa ikiwa linahitajika.
Hifadhi nakala na namba ya kumbukumbu ya kila ombi. Thibitisha muda wa kuwasilisha, ada rasmi na tarehe inayofuata; mazungumzo ya ndani hayaongezi moja kwa moja muda wa kufungua shauri.

appFieldsDraft.titleEn: My employer has not paid my wages. How can I claim them?
appFieldsDraft.titleSw: Mwajiri hajanilipa mshahara. Naudai vipi?
appFieldsDraft.summaryEn: Prepare an itemised wage claim and distinguish agreed pay from disputed deductions. The appropriate labour route depends on the employment relationship.
appFieldsDraft.summarySw: Andaa madai ya mshahara kwa kila kipindi na tenganisha malipo yaliyokubaliwa na makato yanayopingwa. Njia ya madai hutegemea uhusiano wa ajira.
stepsEn: List each unpaid period, amount, hours worked and payments already received; keep attendance and payment records.
If safe, request payment and an explanation of deductions in writing; keep the response.
Ask a labour officer, CMA or a legal-aid adviser to identify the applicable wage-enforcement route and filing time.
Keep a copy and reference number for every submission. Confirm the applicable deadline, official fee and next appointment; internal discussions do not automatically extend a filing deadline.
stepsSw: Orodhesha kila kipindi kisicholipwa, kiasi, saa ulizofanya kazi na malipo yaliyopokelewa; hifadhi kumbukumbu za kazi na malipo.
Ikiwa ni salama, omba malipo na maelezo ya makato kwa maandishi; hifadhi jibu.
Muulize afisa kazi, CMA au mtoa msaada wa kisheria kuhusu njia sahihi ya kudai mshahara na muda wa kuwasilisha.
Hifadhi nakala na namba ya kumbukumbu ya kila ombi. Thibitisha muda wa kuwasilisha, ada rasmi na tarehe inayofuata; mazungumzo ya ndani hayaongezi moja kwa moja muda wa kufungua shauri.

appFieldsDraft.titleEn: I work without a written contract. Can I still seek help?
appFieldsDraft.titleSw: Nafanya kazi bila mkataba wa maandishi. Naweza kupata msaada?
appFieldsDraft.summaryEn: Lack of a written contract does not settle whether an employment relationship exists. Evidence of how the work was organised is important.
appFieldsDraft.summarySw: Kutokuwa na mkataba wa maandishi hakuamui peke yake kama kuna uhusiano wa ajira. Ushahidi wa namna kazi ilivyopangwa ni muhimu.
stepsEn: Collect work messages, rosters, payment records, supervisor details and witnesses.
Record who set your hours, supplied tools, supervised you and paid you; request written employment particulars if safe.
Ask a labour adviser to assess employee status and the correct complaint route; do not assume a casual or contractor label decides it.
Keep a copy and reference number for every submission. Confirm the applicable deadline, official fee and next appointment; internal discussions do not automatically extend a filing deadline.
stepsSw: Kusanya ujumbe wa kazi, ratiba, kumbukumbu za malipo, taarifa za msimamizi na mashahidi.
Andika nani alipanga saa, alitoa vifaa, alikusimamia na kukulipa; omba taarifa za ajira kwa maandishi ikiwa ni salama.
Omba mshauri wa sheria za kazi achunguze hadhi yako na njia ya malalamiko; usidhani jina la kibarua au mkandarasi linaamua suala lote.
Hifadhi nakala na namba ya kumbukumbu ya kila ombi. Thibitisha muda wa kuwasilisha, ada rasmi na tarehe inayofuata; mazungumzo ya ndani hayaongezi moja kwa moja muda wa kufungua shauri.

Tafuta msaada wa sheria za kazi mapema kuhusu ubaguzi, likizo ya uzazi na muda wa kuwasilisha mgogoro wa kufukuzwa.

appFieldsDraft.titleEn: I was injured at work. Where do I seek compensation?
appFieldsDraft.titleSw: Nimeumia kazini. Naomba fidia wapi?
appFieldsDraft.summaryEn: Get medical care and document the work connection. Workplace injury compensation is a distinct process from an ordinary dismissal complaint.
appFieldsDraft.summarySw: Pata matibabu na rekodi uhusiano wa tukio na kazi. Fidia ya kuumia kazini ina utaratibu tofauti na malalamiko ya kufukuzwa.
stepsEn: Keep medical reports, incident details, witness contacts, employer information and expenses.
Report the incident to the employer promptly and ask for the official injury-report reference; avoid signing an unexplained final settlement.
Check Workers Compensation Fund requirements and applicable coverage with WCF or a legal-aid adviser.
Keep a copy and reference number for every submission. Confirm the applicable deadline, official fee and next appointment; internal discussions do not automatically extend a filing deadline.
stepsSw: Hifadhi ripoti za afya, taarifa za tukio, mawasiliano ya mashahidi, taarifa za mwajiri na gharama.
Toa taarifa kwa mwajiri mapema na omba kumbukumbu ya taarifa rasmi ya ajali; epuka kusaini makubaliano ya mwisho usiyoyaelewa.
Thibitisha mahitaji na kama tukio linahusika chini ya Mfuko wa Fidia kwa Wafanyakazi kupitia WCF au mtoa msaada wa kisheria.
Hifadhi nakala na namba ya kumbukumbu ya kila ombi. Thibitisha muda wa kuwasilisha, ada rasmi na tarehe inayofuata; mazungumzo ya ndani hayaongezi moja kwa moja muda wa kufungua shauri.

Omba mwajiri na mfuko husika walinganishe michango; hifadhi majibu yote.
Tumia njia ya malalamiko ya NSSF au PSSSF inayohusika na tafuta msaada wa kisheria ikiwa makato hayajaelezwa.
Hifadhi nakala na namba ya kumbukumbu ya kila ombi. Thibitisha muda wa kuwasilisha, ada rasmi na tarehe inayofuata; mazungumzo ya ndani hayaongezi moja kwa moja muda wa kufungua shauri.

appFieldsDraft.titleEn: I am being sexually harassed or discriminated against at work. Where do I report?
appFieldsDraft.titleSw: Ninanyanyaswa kingono au kubaguliwa kazini. Nitoe taarifa wapi?
appFieldsDraft.summaryEn: Choose a safe reporting channel. Workplace misconduct, employment discrimination and a possible criminal offence may require different parallel responses.
appFieldsDraft.summarySw: Chagua njia salama ya taarifa. Makosa kazini, ubaguzi wa ajira na kosa linaloweza kuwa la jinai vinaweza kuhitaji hatua tofauti zinazokwenda pamoja.
stepsEn: Preserve messages and a private incident timeline; record witnesses without putting yourself at further risk.
Use an employer grievance channel only if safe; request protection from retaliation and confidential handling.
Seek labour legal aid; where violence or a suspected offence is involved, also seek appropriate police or medical assistance.

Use a safe contact method and share sensitive details only with the responsible professional. Do not wait for an app reply if there is immediate danger; seek in-person emergency help where safely possible.
stepsSw: Hifadhi ujumbe na mfuatano wa matukio kwa siri; andika mashahidi bila kujiweka katika hatari zaidi.
Tumia njia ya malalamiko ya mwajiri ikiwa ni salama; omba kulindwa dhidi ya kulipiziwa kisasi na taarifa kushughulikiwa kwa siri.
Tafuta msaada wa sheria za kazi; ikiwa kuna ukatili au kosa linaloshukiwa, tafuta pia msaada unaofaa wa polisi au afya.

Tumia njia salama ya mawasiliano na toa taarifa nyeti kwa mtaalamu anayehusika tu. Usisubiri jibu la programu ukiwa katika hatari ya haraka; tafuta msaada wa dharura ana kwa ana ikiwa ni salama kufanya hivyo.

stepsEn: Keep birth details, care expenses, existing orders and relevant safety facts securely.
Identify the child immediate needs and whether urgent medical or protective assistance is required.
Ask Zanzibar social welfare and child legal aid to confirm the appropriate court or protection route.

Use a safe contact method and share sensitive details only with the responsible professional. Do not wait for an app reply if there is immediate danger; seek in-person emergency help where safely possible.

Tambua mahitaji ya mtoto ya sasa na kama msaada wa haraka wa afya au ulinzi unahitajika.
Uliza ustawi wa jamii na msaada wa sheria za watoto Zanzibar kuhusu mahakama au njia sahihi ya ulinzi.

Tumia njia salama ya mawasiliano na toa taarifa nyeti kwa mtaalamu anayehusika tu. Usisubiri jibu la programu ukiwa katika hatari ya haraka; tafuta msaada wa dharura ana kwa ana ikiwa ni salama kufanya hivyo.

Omba mtaalamu wa ulinzi Zanzibar athibitishe vigezo vya kupokelewa, nafasi ya sasa na usafiri salama kabla ya safari.

appFieldsDraft.titleEn: I cannot afford a lawyer in Zanzibar. How do I find the right legal-aid provider?
appFieldsDraft.titleSw: Siwezi kumudu wakili Zanzibar. Napataje mtoa msaada sahihi?
appFieldsDraft.summaryEn: Use Zanzibar provider information and confirm the provider current registration, service scope and intake. A register entry does not guarantee representation.
appFieldsDraft.summarySw: Tumia taarifa za watoa msaada Zanzibar na thibitisha usajili wa sasa, huduma na kupokelewa. Kuwepo kwenye orodha hakuhakikishi uwakilishi.
stepsEn: Prepare a short summary, district/shehia, key dates, documents and desired assistance.
Check whether the provider handles your issue and island/location and whether any fees or conditions apply.
Use the Zanzibar register and confirmed ZLSC/ZLS or other appropriate provider contacts; obtain an acceptance or onward-referral decision.
Keep a copy and reference number for every submission. Confirm the applicable deadline, official fee and next appointment; internal discussions do not automatically extend a filing deadline.
stepsSw: Andaa maelezo mafupi, wilaya na shehia, tarehe muhimu, nyaraka na msaada unaohitaji.
Thibitisha kama mtoa msaada anashughulikia suala, kisiwa au eneo lako na kama kuna ada au masharti.
Tumia orodha ya Zanzibar na mawasiliano yaliyothibitishwa ya ZLSC, ZLS au mtoa msaada mwingine anayefaa; pata uamuzi wa kupokelewa au rufaa nyingine.
Hifadhi nakala na namba ya kumbukumbu ya kila ombi. Thibitisha muda wa kuwasilisha, ada rasmi na tarehe inayofuata; mazungumzo ya ndani hayaongezi moja kwa moja muda wa kufungua shauri.
